title: Welcome Catch-Up on the First Storage Bundle Discount Credit of a Parking License
content:
**Welcome catch-up** (Parking License storage bundle discount). The first storage bundle discount credit a license ever receives carries a catch-up for the time the household's Storage Rental was already active.

**Definition.** When no storage bundle discount credit has ever been posted on the license and the storage rental started fewer than 60 days before the handling date, the credit carries a prorated welcome catch-up: the bundle rate times the posted fee is multiplied by one plus the days the storage rental was active before the fee line's posting date divided by 30, and the catch-up never exceeds one whole month; when no storage bundle discount credit has ever been posted on the license and the storage rental started 60 days or more before the handling date, the credit carries a flat catch-up of 1 whole month, so the bundle rate times the posted fee is multiplied by one plus 1; in every other case there is no catch-up. The catch-up acts on the product of the bundle rate and the posted fee, and the credit is rounded half up to the cent only once, at the end. The welcome catch-up for the storage-active days before the first covered fee line is carried on that first covered line.

- **Days active before the posting date:** the days from the Storage Rental's start date to the fee line's posting date.
- **Storage started … before the handling date:** the days from the Storage Rental's start date to the handling date.

## Multiplier by case

| Storage bundle discount credit ever posted on the license | Storage Rental started before the handling date | Multiplier on the bundle rate times the posted fee |
|---|---|---|
| never | fewer than 60 days | one plus the days active before the posting date divided by 30, at most 2 |
| never | 60 days or more | 2 (one plus 1 whole month) |
| at least once | any | 1 (no catch-up) |

## Worked examples (hypothetical: bundle rate 0.10, posted fee $65.00, so a product of $6.50)

| Situation | Multiplier | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| first credit; storage started 40 days before the handling date and 12 days before the posting date | one plus 12 divided by 30, which is 1.4 | $9.10 |
| first credit; storage started 50 days before the handling date and 45 days before the posting date | one plus 45 divided by 30 would be 2.5; the catch-up never exceeds one whole month, so 2 | $13.00 |
| first credit; storage started 75 days before the handling date | 2 | $13.00 |
| a credit was already posted on the license earlier | 1 | $6.50 |

A hypothetical odd case shows the single rounding: 0.12 times $95.00 is $11.40; with 7 days active before the posting date the multiplier is one plus 7 divided by 30, about 1.2333, and $11.40 times that multiplier is $14.06 after one rounding at the end.
